literature.title: Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding via Large Neighborhood Search
literature.authors: Li, J.; Chen, Z.; Harabor, D.; Stuckey, P. J.; Koenig, S.
literature.variant: Section 4 LNS; Section 5.3 random neighborhoods; Section 7 Experiment 2 random-priority PP repair; not full adaptive LNS

search.name: LNS-R
search.acceptance: Strictly lower neighborhood weighted delay; individual delays may increase
search.low_level: Exact earliest departure in declared route/layer/lane/speed candidates and 2 s grid; ties by structural cost then airborne duration/canonical structure
search.timing: 10 s improvement budget plus separately recorded template and initialization time; audit and disk IO excluded

inference: Descriptive paired extension; no new p-values or change to the primary three-test family. All 120 records retained, including failures. Shared-SPC starts isolate the improvement operator; 30 independent random-PP starts assess reliance on initialization. Report individually worsened flights and equal-time objectives from anytime trace. No parameter selection on formal seeds.
